## `~builtin-descriptors:Documented`

```ts
type Documented<S> = S extends {
    item: infer I;
} ? Omit<S, 'item'> & {
    readonly doc: string;
    readonly item: {
        readonly [K in keyof I]: Documented<I[K]>;
    };
} : S & {
    readonly doc: string;
};
```

## `~builtin-descriptors:DocumentedSpecs`

```ts
export type DocumentedSpecs<S> = {
    readonly [K in keyof S]: Documented<S[K]>;
};
```
